mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to reduced risk-free discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when FEDFUNDS > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment months) by at least 2% coincident with a falling UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals labor market strengthening, which precedes a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth ≥ 2% and UNRATE monthly decline
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the defined labor indicators' pattern repeating at least 3 times in the prior 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST (residential construction) of 5% or more over the prior 3 months predicts a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as it reflects weakening housing demand and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods of HOUST declines ≥5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in INDPRO (industrial production) exceeding 3% while CPIAUCSL (CPI) is flat suggests robust industrial supply growth without inflationary pressure, which is associated with a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO growth >3% and CPIAUCSL is flat for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 (real GDP) by 2% or more over the prior quarter is followed by a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as market anticipates further policy tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when GDPC1 declines ≥2% in the prior quarter and FEDFUNDS remains below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months and PAYEMS remains stable, it indicates a tight labor market, which is associated with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 2 consecutive months and PAYEMS growth ≤ 0.5%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when the trigger is met at least twice in the prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RSAFS (commercial paper issuance) by 15% in a single month signals liquidity stress and typically precedes a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as investors anticipate market volatility.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during RSAFS spikes of ≥15%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of 4% or more while HOUST is flat suggests supply-side weakness that precedes a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return.
regime_hint: Industrial production contraction without housing weakness
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when INDPRO declines ≥4% and HOUST is flat for 2 months.
